vCard Generator

Create a downloadable vCard (.vcf) contact file from name, phone, email and address — import it into any phone or address book.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the contact's name, phone numbers, email and address.
  2. The valid vCard 3.0 text is generated instantly in the preview box.
  3. Click Download .vcf to save the file, then open it on your phone to import the contact.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a vCard file?

A vCard (.vcf) is the standard file format for electronic business cards. Opening one on a phone or in an email app imports the contact automatically.

Which vCard version is generated?

Version 3.0, which is supported by iPhone, Android, Gmail, Outlook and virtually every address-book app.

Is my contact data uploaded anywhere?

No. The vCard is generated entirely in your browser and never leaves your device.
